senses.gloss:
(I)--a son of ब्रह्मा, born of his eyes.
1: भा. III. १२. २२ & २४; M. 3. 6; 9. २७.
Father of Soma, born of his eyes.
2: भा. IX. १४. 2-3; Br. III. ६५. 1 & ४७; वा. 1. १३८; 3. 3; ३०. ४८.
Married अनसूया, a daughter of Kardama (दक्ष-वा।). Their son was दत्तात्रेय (s.v.). Taught आन्वीक्षिकी to Alarka, प्रःलाद and others.
3: भा. I. 3. ११; III. २४. २२. Br. II. 9. ५६.
Paid a visit to भीष्म who was in his death-bed.
4: भा. I. 9. 7.
Came to see परीक्षित् practising प्रायोपवेश।
5: भा. I. १९. 9.
A sage.
6: Ib. II. 7. 4. वा. ९०. 1-8.
Was engaged with his wife in meditation at Mount ऋक्ष by प्राणायाम for the birth of a son. His praise of त्रिमूर्तिस् who appeared before him, and blessed him with three glorious sons, being their ओwन् अम्शस्. Accordingly Datta (विष्णु), दुर्वासस् (शिव), and Soma (ब्रह्मा) were born.
7: भा. IV. 1. १५-33; Vi. IV. 6. 5-6.
Pointed out to पृथु's son, Indra running away with the consecrated horse twice and urged him to slay him.
8: भा. IV. १९. १२-15 and २१.
Had not yet seen the Supreme Being.
9: Ib. IV. २९. ४३.
A sage of the Vaivasvata epoch.
१०: Ib. VIII. १३. 5; Br. II. ३८. २५.
Went with कृष्ण to मिथिला.
११: भा. X. ८६. १८.
The sage who presides over the month of शुक्र
१२: Ib. XII. ११. ३५.
and शुचि.
१३: Br. II. २३. 5. वा. ५२. 6. Vi. II. १०. 7; III. 1. ३२.
A मन्त्रकार: took उत्तानपाद as his son.
१४: Br. II. २७. १०४; ३२. ९६ & ११३.
Had a daughter, a Brahma- वादिनी. Visited परशुराम engaged in austerities.
१५: Br. III. २३. 4.
Wor- shipped पितृस् by श्राद्ध and relieved Soma of the disease राजयक्ष्म।
१६: Br. III. १०. १११; वा. ७३. ६३;
Appointed by ब्रह्मा for creation of the world he performed the तपस् called अनुत्तम when शिव saw him: acted as होता for Soma's राजसूय:
१६: (a) M. २३. 2-२०.
Hermitage in the Himalayas, visited by पुरूरवस्:
१७: M. १०२. १९; ११८. ६२ & ७७; १२०. ४५; १२६. 7.
Praised शिव out to destroy Tripuram.
१८: M. १३३. ६७.
(II)--one of the sages who left for पिण्डारक. भा. XI. 1. १२. [page१-042+ ३३]
(III)--the third प्रजापति Of स्वायम्भुव epoch, created by ब्रह्मा from अहं तृतीय। Br. I. 1. ११७; 5. ७०; II. 9. १८, २३; वा. ३१. १६; ३४. ६२; ६५. ४५; Vi. V. 1. १७.

(V)--born in वारुणी यज्ञ from Agni's flames;
1: Br. III. 1. २१ & ४४; 8. ७३; M. १७१. २७; १९२. १०; १९५. 9; वा. ६२. १७; ६४. २७; Vi. I. 7. 5, 7.
Had ten beautiful and chaste wives, all daughters of Bha- द्राश्व and घृताची. His ten sons were all known as आत्रे- yas,
2: वा. ७०. ६७-76.
also स्वस्त्यात्रेयस्; a महऋषि and a मन्त्रकृत्। Tra यार्षेय with वसिष्ठ and जातूकर्ण: a contemporary of वृद्ध Garga.
3: M. १४५. ९०, १०७-9; १९७. 1 & 4; २००. १९; २२९. 2 & 3; वा. ५९. १०४.
One of the १८ writers on architecture. Has a place in the विश्वचक्र।
4: M. २५२. 2; २८५-6.
(VI)--the अवतार् of the Lord in the १२थ् द्वापर in the Haimaka forest with sons with bath and ashes. वा. २३. १५५.
(VII)--a son of Gautama, an अवतार् of the Lord. वा. २३. १६४.
--a special rite in the यज्ञस् after the cele- brated sage Atri. वा. ७०. ७३.

--a pupil of सूत;
1: Va. ६१. ५६.
the last reference is to the sage in the Raivatamanvantara.
2: वा. ६२. १७, ५४.
Sage of the तामस man- vantara.
3: वा. ६२. ४१.
आत्रेय S4aradvata one of the seven sages;
4: वा. १००. ११.
आत्रे- यवारुनि,
5: वा. १००. ८२.
निष्प्रकम्प,
6: वा. १००. १०७.
सूतपूः.
7: वा. १००. ९६; १०६. ३९.
[page१-153+ २८]
(I)--a deva गण of the पितृस्, like स्वस्त्यात्रेय, Br. III. 1. ५१; 8. ८१.
(II)--the five sons of Atri and अनसूया; Saty- netra, Havya, आपोमूर्टि, शनीश्वर and Soma. वा. २८. १८-20; Br. II. ११. २३-24.
